effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, their ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects don't affect this Digimon, and it gets +1000 DP for each of its face-down digivolution cards.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] You may choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Your opponent attacks with the chosen Digimon.
